questions.question: On this day in 1990, who was formally installed as the 125th monarch of Japan?
questions.explanation: On 12 November 1990, Crown Prince Akihito was officially enthroned as Emperor Akihito of Japan.
questions.context:
On this day in 1990: Crown Prince Akihito is formally installed as Emperor Akihito of Japan, becoming the 125th Japanese monarch.
Crown prince (Male heir to a throne): A crown prince or hereditary prince is the heir apparent to the throne in a royal or imperial monarchy. The female form of the title, crown princess, is held by a woman who is heir apparent or is married to the heir apparent.

questions.question: Which Indian action comedy film directed by Jithu Madhavan features a visually impaired police officer forced to solve a cold case?
questions.explanation: The 2026 Tamil action comedy Scene focuses on a visually impaired DSP reopening an unfinished investigation alongside a challenging team.
questions.context: Scene (2026 film) (Indian film by Jithu Madhavan): Scene is a 2026 Indian Tamil-language action comedy film written and directed by Jithu Madhavan. Produced by Suriya and Jyothika's 2D Entertainment and the newly established Zhagaram Studios, the film stars Suriya, Naslen and Nazriya Nazim, with Anandaraj, Lal, Rajpriyan, Suresh Mathiyalagan and Gajaraj in supporting roles. It revolves around a visually-impaired DSP being forced to reopen an unfinished case and solve it with a troublesome team.

questions.question: Which nation's mens national soccer team hired Argentine manager Mauricio Pochettino as head coach?
questions.explanation: Former professional player Mauricio Pochettino serves as head coach of the United States men's national soccer team.
questions.context: Mauricio Pochettino (Argentine football manager (born 1972)): Mauricio Roberto Pochettino Trossero is an Argentine professional football manager and former footballer who is the head coach of the United States national soccer team.

questions.question: Which English producer, screenwriter, and former journalist established the production firm Instinct Productions?
questions.explanation: Jemima Goldsmith, formerly known as Jemima Khan, founded the TV production company Instinct Productions.
questions.context: Jemima Goldsmith (British journalist and producer): Jemima Marcelle Goldsmith O'Reilly, formerly known professionally as Jemima Khan, is an English TV and film producer and screenwriter. She is the founder of Instinct Productions, a television production company. Previously she was an associate editor for the British political and cultural magazine The New Statesman and European editor-at-large for the American magazine Vanity Fair.

questions.question: Which political office was Jim Jordan chosen to fill for the 120th United States Congress starting in January 2027?
questions.explanation: Representative Jim Jordan of Ohio was selected in late 2026 to lead the House Republicans as Minority Leader for the 120th Congress.
questions.context: Jim Jordan (American politician (born 1964)): James Daniel Jordan is an American politician who has served in the U.S. House of Representatives as the representative for Ohio's 4th congressional district since 2007. Currently in his 10th term in the House, Jordan is a member of the Republican Party. He was chosen on November 10, 2026, to serve as the Republican House Minority Leader in the 120th Congress which will convene January 3, 2027.
